project.name: jawelte (flow-assert-module aggregator)
project.description: Records the CDI call-flow of a test method and asserts it against an expected sequence-diagram. @EnableFlowAssert turns the recording on, @ExpectedFlow / FlowDiff compare the recording against a checked-in diagram, and the notation follows the expected file's extension - Mermaid for .mmd, PlantUML for .puml, anything else from a registered FlowDialect. flow-assert-module/api carries the annotations, the fluent FlowDiff entry point and the FlowDialect / FlowDiffEngine / FlowRecordingPort ports; flow-assert-module/impl bridges to the cdi-flow recorder, captures the flows of the running test method and ships the two built-in dialects plus the alignment-based diff engine.
